name: Acquia Content Hub unsubscribe content
description: Adds an editor checkbox to exclude content from Acquia Content Hub syndication.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Introduction 
 Module that allows to exclude chosen content from Content Hub synchronisation to be able to keep local versions if needed.

 Version 3.1.x brought in compatibility with Content Hub's "Manual Unsubscribe" feature, while also maintaining compatibility with the previous unsubscribe module.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 This module requires Acquia Content Hub Unsubscribe part of Acquia Content Hub module > 2.x.

 3.1.x and above 
 The 3.1.x release and above of this module works for Drupal 9 and 10 and 11! And requires using Acquia Content Hub 3.3.x and above.

 3.0.x and below 
 The 3.0.x release and above of this module works for Drupal 9 and 10! And can be used with Acquia Content Hub 3.2.x and below.

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Consult https://www.drupal.org/docs/extending-drupal/installing-modules to see how to install and manage modules in Drupal 8.

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 No configuration is needed.

 Back to top
